data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## What
Update 3 existing documentation files to reflect the bridge sync chronic-silence epic changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

### CLAUDE.md changes
- In the Architecture section, add/update bridge subsystem entry to mention:
  - BRIDGE_ENV_ID: required non-empty UUID repo variable; cold-start missing → BRIDGE_ALERT migration on first run
  - BRIDGE_USER_MAP: optional JSON object (env var); case-insensitive email-key → Jira accountId mapping; no-match → BRIDGE_ALERT + explicit null-assignee via PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/assignee
  - Outbound checkpoint cursor: .outbound-checkpoint.json stored on tickets branch; SHA-based; 500-commit cap + BRIDGE_ALERT on exceed; 4 recovery cases all seed at HEAD
- Max 6 lines added (CLAUDE.md bloat rule: architecture section additions must be one-line references per item)

### plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md changes
- Add two entries:
  1. BRIDGE_USER_MAP: type=JSON object (env var), default='{}', shape: {"email@example.com": "jira-account-id"}, case-insensitive email key lookup; no-match triggers BRIDGE_ALERT + explicit null-assignee
  2. BRIDGE_ENV_ID: type=UUID string (repo variable, not env var), required non-empty; missing or empty triggers BRIDGE_ALERT migration on first outbound run
- Follow existing CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md format exactly

### .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md changes
- Add entry: 'Outbound bridge silent-drop: HEAD~1..HEAD blindness'
  - Symptom: STATUS/CREATE events added in commits older than HEAD~1 are not pushed to Jira
  - Root cause: bridge-outbound.py used HEAD~1..HEAD diff window; replaced with cursor-based fetch in epic 1cec-29dc
  - Recovery: .outbound-checkpoint.json on tickets branch; on missing/corrupt: seeds at HEAD with BRIDGE_ALERT
  - Migration: when BRIDGE_ENV_ID is newly set (was empty), one-shot BRIDGE_ALERT is written; this is expected

## Files to Modify
- CLAUDE.md
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md
data.title: UPDATE: document BRIDGE_USER_MAP, BRIDGE_ENV_ID, cursor semantics in CLAUDE.md, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, KNOWN-ISSUES.md
